functional.definition: D(X) = sup over closed spherical caps C of |#(X n C)/N - sigma(C)|, sigma the normalized area
functional.critical_point: balanced: a nonnegative combination of the gradients of the worst caps vanishes (Clarke stationary)
functional.gauge: x0 = (0,0,1), x1 in the xz-plane with x > 0 (coordinates are stored as found; the gauge applies to q)
